mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without regime-specific triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2% or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 5.0% signals labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS increase by more than 0.5% monthly, SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 270) trigger monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 270.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production indicates strengthening economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days without triggering conditions.
failure_condition: When INDPRO growth exceeds 0.1% monthly, SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth exceeding 0.5% in a month signals labor market strength that supports consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly, SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly GDP expansion and housing starts growth indicate broad economic strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 growth exceeds 0.5% quarterly and HOUST growth exceeds 0.3% monthly, SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%) indicate economic weakness that suppresses corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.0%.
